items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: I’ve been able to ask this question to Orrin Keepnews and a few other people

ctx.x: Do you have a definition of your own producing? I’ve been able to ask this question to Orrin Keepnews and a few other people because it’s not exactly a definable occupation.

Right. Right. There’s as many different ways to produce a record as there are to paint a picture or whatever. I mean I’m — the way I produce actually is not so much production as support. You know if I’m in there with Mose Allison, Mose knows who Mose Allison is. My job is to get the obstacles out of his way and make it possible for him to do what he’s trying to do. And in the instance like that, that could be everything from taking care of all the mechanics of booking the sessions and the musicians, I mean it…
